snippet.title: PlayStation - Arubarea no Otome  -Uruwashi no Seishikitachi- (1998)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Arubarea no Otome ~Uruwashi no Seishikitachi~ is a Strategy game, developed and published by NCS, which was released in Japan in 1998.
